The gakkul vat, which puts us in a happy mood! The lamsare vat, which makes the heart rejoice! The ugurbal jar, glory of the house! The caggub jar, filled with beer! The amam jar, which carries the beer from the lamsare vat!… As I spin around the lake of beer, while feeling wonderful, Feeling wonderful, while drinking beer, in a blissful mood, While drinking alcohol and feeling exhilarated, With a joyful heart and a contented liver, My heart is a heart filled with joy!
